remarks: Settle in to the summer you've been waiting for. This beautifully furnished home lives like a private resort, where days begin poolside and evenings unfold on the expansive terrace with outdoor kitchen and fire pit, surrounded by lush, manicured grounds. Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, every space invites you to slow down, entertain easily, and enjoy the season.  Inside, light-filled rooms offer comfort and flexibility with five bedrooms, a dedicated home office, four full baths, and two powder rooms. The oversized eat-in kitchen-complete with honed granite counters, high-end stainless appliances, and a wet bar-anchors the home and makes gathering feel natural and relaxed. Multiple living areas provide room to unwind, work remotely, or enjoy movie nights, while an upstairs playroom with projector, a private gym, and sauna elevate everyday living. Tesla charging station. Fabulous in-town location with easy NYC access. Summer at its very best! Arrive, exhale, and enjoy.
